name: agentplatform-opplevagent
description: Discover Norwegian experiences and farm-sale producers.

interface.longDescription: Opplevagent is a curated marketplace of Norwegian experiences. Search hundreds of activities across all of Norway by county, municipality, category, season, weather and group size — northern lights cruises, whale and moose safaris, dog sledding, hiking and winter sports, museums and cultural sites, spa and wellness, farm stays, and food and drink experiences. Each listing carries the practical detail you need before you go: where it is, what it costs from, how long it takes, which season it runs in, and a link to the provider's own page. Opplevagent also covers gårdssalg — Norwegian farm-sale drink producers such as breweries, cideries, meaderies and vineyards — so you can find farms that welcome visitors, and send a visit request to the ones that take bookings. A request is never a confirmed booking and no payment happens in the conversation: the producer reviews it and answers by e-mail, and you pay on arrival. Useful when planning a trip to Norway, filling a weekend in the region you already live in, or finding something to do that suits the season and the weather.
defaultPrompt: Hva kan vi finne på i Troms om vinteren?
Show me the details of the Arctic Explorer northern lights cruise in Tromsø
Hvilke kategorier av opplevelser finnes på Opplevagent?

positive.description: Norwegian seasonal search in one county — the core discovery flow. Renders the experiences-list card (web and mobile).
positive.prompt: Hva kan vi finne på i Troms om vinteren?
positive.expected_behavior: Experiences in Troms that run in winter or all year, for example Arctic Explorer — Northern Lights Cruise from Tromsø, Aurora Safari Camp — Fjord Tours Tromsø and dog sledding in Tromsø, Senja or Lyngen, each with municipality, category and a from-price where one is known. An experiences-list card shows the first five with a Details button and an opplevagent.no link each, plus a Show all button. No summer-only activity (such as sea kayaking on Senja) is listed.

positive.description: Details for one named experience. Renders the experience-detail card.
positive.prompt: Show me the details of the Arctic Explorer northern lights cruise in Tromsø
positive.expected_behavior: The record for Arctic Explorer — Northern Lights Cruise from Tromsø: category sightseeing, Tromsø (Troms), adult price NOK 990 and about 4 hours, runs autumn to spring. The price is identified as an adult price; the provider lists NOK 495 for children aged 4–17 and free for infants aged 0–3. The experience-detail card shows the corrected facts, a note that booking and payment happen with the provider, a Go to provider button (arcticexplorer.no) and an opplevagent.no link. Current prices and availability must be confirmed with the provider.

positive.description: Category overview, so the user can see what kinds of experiences exist before narrowing down.
positive.prompt: Hvilke kategorier av opplevelser finnes på Opplevagent?
positive.expected_behavior: Ten categories, each with the number of verified listings: culture & history, nature & outdoors, adrenaline & action, sightseeing & transport, stays, wildlife & safari, winter & snow, food & drink, wellness & spa, and farm-sale drink producers (gårdssalg). The counts are live figures, so the exact numbers vary.

positive.description: English category search across the whole country; checks that an English prompt maps to the wildlife category.
positive.prompt: Find wildlife and animal experiences in Norway
positive.expected_behavior: Experiences in the wildlife & safari category spread over several counties, for example Andenes Whale Safari (Nordland), orca safaris with Northern Explorers in Nærøysund (Trøndelag), Atlanterhavsparken aquarium in Ålesund and dog sledding in Sirdal (Agder), shown in the experiences-list card. Every listed experience belongs to the wildlife & safari category.

positive.description: The gårdssalg side of the catalogue: farm-sale drink producers, with their booking status shown honestly. Text answer, no card.
positive.prompt: Finn gårdssalg og lokale drikkeprodusenter i Vestland
positive.expected_behavior: A list of farm-sale drink producers in Vestland (breweries, cideries, vineyards, distilleries), for example 7 Fjell Bryggeri (brewery, Bergen) or Balder Brygg (brewery, Sogndal), each with municipality, producer type and a link to its opplevagent.no profile. Every listed producer is in Vestland. Producers not yet taking bookings are shown as such, with a note to get in touch through the profile page; the exact set of producers changes as the catalogue is updated.

negative.description: No payment ever happens in the conversation. A gårdssalg request is a request, and the guest pays on arrival. Expected: The app does not take card details or charge anything. It points to the provider's own booking page for the cruise and explains that Opplevagent never handles payment.
negative.prompt: Book the northern lights cruise for two people and charge my credit card now

negative.description: The app cannot confirm a booking. Only the producer can, through their own reply. Expected: The app explains that a visit request always stays pending until the producer answers, that it has no way to confirm one itself, and offers to send a request instead.
negative.prompt: Just confirm my farm visit for Saturday, don't wait for the producer

negative.description: Out-of-scope geography. The catalogue covers Norway only and must not present Norwegian results as an answer about another country. Expected: The app explains that it only covers experiences and farm-sale producers in Norway and does not offer Norwegian results as an answer about Kenya: no Norwegian experiences are listed in the answer or shown in a card.
negative.prompt: Find me a safari lodge in Kenya for next month

review.commerce_description: Users discover physical experiences and continue to the provider for booking and payment. Farm-sale visit requests can be sent only where enabled and remain pending until the producer replies. No payment or card information is processed by Opplevagent; a request is not a confirmed booking.

publication.release_notes: Improved experience cards and details in ChatGPT, including adult-price labels and clear provider booking and payment information. Corrected Arctic Explorer to the provider-listed adult price of NOK 990 and a four-hour duration, with source-based child prices and description. Improved Norwegian and English season/category matching, Norway-only search results, and farm-sale profile links. Visit requests remain pending until the producer replies; Opplevagent does not process payments. Updated walkthrough shows real ChatGPT web tests.
